## Findings

1. Low. A protocol regression can hang the unit suite instead of failing it: with LOGIN swapped in, `npm test` never finished. GitHub would only kill it at the 6-hour job limit. Routed to C2: add `--test-timeout` to the test scripts and `timeout-minutes` to the CI jobs.
2. Note for C2. `uidSearch()` only rejects line breaks; values are not quoted. Routed to C2: the filter translator must build SEARCH values with `quote()`.
3. Note for C6. `ImapError` carries the raw server response in `serverText`. REQ-13-3 bars raw server error text from logs. Routed to C6 with a required test.
4. Observation. On hosts without LITERAL+, untagged responses that arrive before the `+` continuation are dropped. Both hosts advertise LITERAL+, so this path is unit-tested only. No action.

## Builder choices reviewed

All consistent with the spec; none needs a spec question: timeout covers the whole step (REQ-4-8 says "each command"), close bounded at the command value, a missing secret reports as an auth failure, any refused AUTHENTICATE counts as an auth failure, a timed-out account stays failed for the request (REQ-4-9, REQ-4-10).
